calibration.method: surface fitted to real SPY option chains, then checked by booking the deployed structure against natural (worst-side) fills on every one of those chains

v2_linear_skew.verdict: booked ~1.37x the credit the market pays

booked_vs_natural.structure_tested: 5% OTM / 5% wide / ~60 days, real SPY chains 2019-2026
booked_vs_natural.note: Measured by pricing the deployed structure on every real chain and comparing to a natural (worst-side) fill. Agrees with live_validation.py's 1.413 on live SPY quotes. The fix is the skew SHAPE, not the IV level.

cadence: one new rung every week (put book) / month (call book)

regime.filter: enter only when SPY >= its 200-day average

put.label: Put credit spread (the strategy)
put.today_action: HOLD — 8 rungs open; next weekly rung next session

call.label: Bull call spread (max ROR/trade)
call.today_action: HOLD — 4 rungs open; next monthly rung the first session of next month

note: Pricing model v2: carry (historical T-bill), volatility skew, mean-reverting blended IV, 3% slippage — audited so the backtest pays real-world premiums. ~88-93% accurate, NOT 99%; concurrent rungs lose together in a crash (the at-risk cap bounds it).
